editorial.thesis: A hospitality-and-learning city of about 1.4 million. Its retail is heavy on coaching & training and fitness & wellness, and thin on apparel, footwear & jewellery and grocery & daily needs — and 28% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is ahead of Delhi. 25.41 chain outlets per lakh residents against 18.83 in Delhi; 35 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Apollo Pharmacy 77, MedPlus 37, Reliance Trends 34.

The mapped economy leans to hotels & stays. Shares of all mapped places: hotels & stays 7.5% (Delhi 4.4%); education 11.2% (Delhi 7.9%); grocery & daily needs 1.3% (Delhi 2.2%); malls & department stores 0.5% (Delhi 0.8%). Raw counts would mislead because Delhi is mapped more completely (87,703 places against 15,225), so we compare mix, not counts.

Supply and demand are misaligned. 4 zones hold 28% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Lewis Road · Samantarapur alone has about 159,000 residents and 32 mapped food & drink places.

Retail is less concentrated than in Delhi. 47% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Delhi 47%). The largest cores are Kiit Road · Chandrasekharpur (1,019 places) and Saheed Nagar · Sahid Nagar (811).

The widest brand gaps against Delhi. Café Coffee Day 25 outlets vs 145; Domino's 22 outlets vs 140; McDonald's 0 outlets vs 75. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 10 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Delhi, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Lewis Road · Samantarapur and Kiit Road · Chandrasekharpur are the largest zones by residents (159,000 and 126,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 47% of all commercial places, and Kiit Road · Chandrasekharpur alone lists 1,019.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Kiit Road · Chandrasekharpur holds 36 of the 360 tracked chain outlets, and Kalinga Nagar · Ruchika Market adds 32.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Kiit Road · Chandrasekharpur and Saheed Nagar · Sahid Nagar lead on education places (163 and 102, with 35 and 55 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Lewis Road · Samantarapur and Kalinga Vihar · Kalinga Nagar. The blue cores include Kiit Road · Chandrasekharpur.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (87,703 places in Delhi against 15,225 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Delhi; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Delhi, Bhubaneswar's mapped places over-index on hotels & stays (7.5% vs 4.4%), education (11.2% vs 7.9%), services & crafts (8.6% vs 6.3%) and under-index on grocery & daily needs (1.3% vs 2.2%), malls & department stores (0.5% vs 0.8%), shops & retail (13.1% vs 17.2%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 360 outlets of 35 tracked national brands within 10 km — 25.41 per lakh residents against Delhi's 18.83 (1289 outlets of 45 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Delhi are Café Coffee Day (25 vs 145); Domino's (22 vs 140); McDonald's (0 vs 75). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Delhi's, so low means thin by Delhi's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 10 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Bhubaneswar's age mix against Delhi: children (0–14) 21.3% vs 23.1%, 15–24 19.4% vs 20.4%, working age 50.2% vs 49.7%, 60+ 9.1% vs 6.8%. Under-25s are 41% of residents.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 5.7% of mapped places against 5.7% in Delhi, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Domino's 22 (Delhi 140), Wow! Momo 14 (Delhi 32), Pizza Hut 11 (Delhi 68), KFC 10 (Delhi 51).
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 2.1% of mapped places against 2.1% in Delhi, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Café Coffee Day 25 (Delhi 145), Starbucks 5 (Delhi 33). No mapped outlet in either city: Chai Sutta Bar.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.7% of mapped places against 0.7% in Delhi, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Baskin Robbins 9 (Delhi 29), Cream Stone 1 (Delhi 0).
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 1.3% of mapped places against 2.2% in Delhi — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Smart / Fresh 27 (Delhi 21), Vishal Mega Mart 4 (Delhi 11), DMart 3 (Delhi 7), Big Bazaar 3 (Delhi 8). No mapped outlet in either city: Star Bazaar.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 1.4% of mapped places against 1.2% in Delhi — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Apollo Pharmacy 77 (Delhi 108), MedPlus 37 (Delhi 0). No mapped outlet in either city: Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 3.8% of mapped places against 7.0% in Delhi — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Trends 34 (Delhi 22), Titan 12 (Delhi 21), Bata 10 (Delhi 66), Pantaloons 8 (Delhi 8).
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 7.5% of mapped places against 7.9% in Delhi, so the mix is level.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 3.6% of mapped places against 2.7% in Delhi — above its share.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 4.7% of mapped places against 3.9% in Delhi — above its share.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
